findings.problem: The product name and several compound identifiers are SMILES strings rather than names, which A2 rule 8 forbids on these flattened fields.
findings.should_be: the label the patent itself gives that structure, 式(I)化合物, or the IUPAC name the Background records already use; the SMILES belongs in the A1 compound record's aliases

findings.problem: Scheme (vi) on page p06 draws four arrows (aryl bromide, carboxylic acid, acid chloride, enol ester, tembotrione) but the Summary records collapse arrows two and three into one acid-plus-dione step, so the acid chloride intermediate and its own step are missing from this section entirely.
findings.artifact_says: one record: reactants the acid and cyclohexane-1,3-dione, product the enol ester
findings.should_be: two records, acid to acid chloride and acid chloride plus dione to enol ester, as the Preparation Routes section already records for the same route (Scheme Step 7 and Scheme Step 8)

findings.problem: Examples 6 and 7 are the same palladium hydroxycarbonylation of the formula (IV) bromide differing only in ligand and solvent, but Example 6 is classed other_cross_coupling and Example 7 other.
findings.quote: 向高压釜中加入式(IV)化合物40g、水20g、三乙胺26.49g、PdCl2催化剂0.4g、配体1,3-双(二苯基膦)丙烷3.95g、溶剂四氢呋喃400g
findings.artifact_says: Example 6_Step 1 reaction_class other_cross_coupling; Example 7_Step 1 reaction_class other

findings.problem: The same formula (IV) to formula (V) carbonylation is classed four ways across the artifact: other_cross_coupling in Preparation Routes Step 7 and Scheme Step 6 and Example 6, other in Claims Step (v), Summary Scheme Step 5 and Example 7.
findings.should_be: the same class used for Preparation Routes Step 7 for every telling of this transformation

findings.problem: The paragraph prints a reaction time of 10 to 20 h and the record carries time_h null.
findings.should_be: record the printed 10 to 20 h; time_h holds one float, so record 10.0 with the range in notes, or carry the range in notes explicitly rather than leaving the field silent

findings.problem: The one-pot record carries only the second stage, 70 C and 5 h; the carbonylation stage temperature range 80 to 85 C and its 8 h appear in no structured field, only in prose notes and one_pot_steps.
findings.quote: 以约1～4MPa的压力通入CO，在80～85℃反应约8h后降温至70℃，加入2g丙酮氰醇，继续反应5h
findings.should_be: keep 70 C and 5 h per the one-pot rule but carry 80 to 85 C and 8 h explicitly, so the range is not lost to a reader of the structured fields

findings.problem: temperature is not_specified although the paragraph prints three temperatures; they all belong to the first of the two one-pot transformations and were pushed into addition_profile only.
findings.quote: 在20℃下将5.1％盐酸1165g加入到四口瓶中，滴加3-氯-2-甲基苯胺100g，滴加完毕后，在0℃进一步滴加20％NaNO2水溶液251.41g，滴加过程中控温不超过-5～10℃
findings.should_be: a judgement call: the one-pot rule points at the final transformation, which prints nothing, but leaving not_specified on a step whose only printed temperatures are -5 to 10 C makes this example incomparable with Examples 2 to 11; record the -5 to 10 C range and name the split in notes
